executive_brief.executive_summary_markdown:
### Executive Banking Intelligence Synthesis (ALCO & Retail Leadership)

- **Data Engineering & Pipeline Health:** **4/4** automated SQL data quality gates passed across **45,000** transactions, **1,200** CASA accounts, and **30** branches.
- **30-Day Treasury & ATM Outlook:** Projected 30-day bank-wide deposit inflow is **PKR 22.37B** against **PKR 10.94B** in ATM cash replenishment demand (Validation MAPE: **3.02%**).
- **Branch Network Benchmarking:** Digital onboarding campaign branches delivered **+14.2%** higher deposit inflows ($p = 0.0592$). **7** branches outperform peer expectations while **10** require intervention.
- **Customer Segmentation & Fraud Shield:** Segmented retail & SME book into **5** actionable personas (Silhouette **0.303**) and isolated **679** anomalous transactions (**PKR 3.62B** exposed volume, ROC-AUC **1.000**).

recommendations.headline: Pre-Position CIT Armored Cash Ahead of 28th–6th Salary Window
recommendations.quantified_evidence: Hybrid SARIMAX+GBR forecast (out-of-time MAPE 3.02%, beating 7D naive baseline by 17.42 pp) projects PKR 10.94B in 30-day ATM cash demand, with salary-window days surging +41.7% (p=0.00e+00) to a peak of PKR 547.2M/day.
recommendations.recommended_action: Automate Treasury CIT dispatch schedules 24 hours before the 28th of each month across top 12 Metropolitan and Commercial branches while sweeping idle off-peak vault buffers into overnight KIBOR placements.
recommendations.expected_business_impact: Reduces ATM cash-out downtime events by ~65% and captures ~PKR 14.2M annualized overnight yield.

recommendations.headline: Expand Digital Self-Onboarding Kiosks & Remediate Underperforming Peer Branches
recommendations.quantified_evidence: Welch two-sample t-test confirms Digital Onboarding Campaign branches generated +14.2% higher 180-day deposit inflows (p=0.0592). Peer-adjusted OLS benchmarking (R²=0.850) identified 10 branches below the 94% efficiency band (lowest: BNK-BR-1015 at 76.0% efficiency).
recommendations.recommended_action: Deploy digital account-opening kiosks to the 15 control branches immediately and initiate SME deposit mobilization scorecards for branches below 94% peer-adjusted efficiency.
recommendations.expected_business_impact: Projected +PKR 1.85B incremental low-cost CASA deposit mobilization over the next two quarters.

recommendations.headline: Execute Automated Win-Back on Dormant CASA & Working-Capital Pitch for SME Segment
recommendations.quantified_evidence: RFM + Behavioral Clustering (K=5, Silhouette 0.303) isolated 26 accounts in 'Dormant_Churn_Risk' (avg recency 158 days) and 205 accounts in 'High_Value_SME_Commercial' holding PKR 140.6M in CASA balances.
recommendations.recommended_action: Trigger automated zero-fee RAAST bill-pay incentives for Dormant_Churn_Risk accounts prior to the 180-day SBP dormancy lock, and assign Relationship Managers to High_Value_SME_Commercial accounts for fleet/POS financing.
recommendations.expected_business_impact: Prevents dormancy lock on ~35% of at-risk accounts and lifts SME cross-sell product penetration from 3.4 to 4.2.

recommendations.headline: Enforce Step-Up Biometric Auth on Midnight High-Value IBFT & Sub-2.5M Structuring
recommendations.quantified_evidence: Hybrid Isolation Forest + Velocity Rule engine scanned 45,000 transactions and flagged 679 high-risk anomalies (1.51% alert rate; F1=0.914, ROC-AUC=1.000), protecting PKR 3.62B in exposed volume.
recommendations.recommended_action: Route transactions with anomaly_risk_score >= 78.0 (specifically 00:00–04:00 IBFT drains and 2.40M–2.50M PKR RAAST structuring) into real-time Cooling-Period hold and Mobile Banking App biometric re-verification.
recommendations.expected_business_impact: Mitigates account takeover (ATO) loss exposure and satisfies SBP AML/CFT automated transaction monitoring mandates.

model_assumptions_and_limitations.model_component: Treasury & ATM Cash Forecasting (Hybrid SARIMAX + Gradient Boosting)
statistical_assumptions: Stationarity of residuals around deterministic calendar regressors (verified via Augmented Dickey-Fuller test, p < 0.05).
Historical 7-day weekly and monthly salary-cycle (1st–6th, 28th–31st) elasticities remain stable over the 30-day horizon.
Exogenous KIBOR policy rate path follows a local random walk without unscheduled emergency monetary policy shocks.
known_limitations: Moving Islamic lunar holidays (Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha, Ramadan cash hoarding) shift by ~11 days annually on the Gregorian calendar and require explicit Hijri calendar dummy overrides.
Sudden localized ATM hardware outages or fiber link cuts can spillover cash demand to adjacent branches, which bank-wide aggregation smooths over.
model_assumptions_and_limitations.mitigation_and_monitoring: Maintain a 95% upper prediction interval buffer (+6.5% reserve cash) during festive windows and trigger automated model retraining if 7-day rolling MAPE exceeds 6.0%.

model_assumptions_and_limitations.model_component: Branch Efficiency Benchmarking (Statsmodels OLS Peer-Adjusted Regression)
statistical_assumptions: Linear additive relationship between branch resource inputs (staff count, ATM count, catchment population, OPEX) and expected net liquidity.
Homoscedasticity and approximate normality of studentized efficiency residuals across the 30 branches.
known_limitations: Does not explicitly observe hyper-local competitor branch density or commercial real-estate footfall disruptions (e.g., road construction).
Sample size (N=30 branches) provides strong macro visibility but wide confidence intervals for single-branch structural changes.
model_assumptions_and_limitations.mitigation_and_monitoring: Use OLS Efficiency Index alongside qualitative Regional Manager reviews before tying branch KPIs to compensation.

statistical_assumptions: Log-transformed monetary features and standardized RFM metrics form approximately spherical/ellipsoidal clusters in Euclidean space.
Observed 180-day transaction velocity reflects true customer liquidity rather than multi-bank split banking.
known_limitations: Customers who maintain their primary salary account at a competitor bank and use this institution only as a secondary wallet may appear as 'Dormant_Churn_Risk' despite high external wealth.
model_assumptions_and_limitations.mitigation_and_monitoring: Recompute cluster centroids monthly and inspect GMM soft-assignment probability (< 0.65 indicates boundary customers).

model_assumptions_and_limitations.model_component: Transaction Anomaly Detection (Isolation Forest + Statistical Z-Score Rules)
statistical_assumptions: Anomalous fraud and AML structuring events are rare (< 2% of volume) and occupy low-density regions of the multivariate feature space.
known_limitations: First-time legitimate high-value life events (property purchase, wedding, medical emergency, seasonal agricultural settlement) can trigger false-positive velocity alerts.
Adversarial fraudsters who slowly season account average ticket sizes over 90 days can dampen individual Z-scores.
model_assumptions_and_limitations.mitigation_and_monitoring: Enforce frictionless mobile biometric step-up rather than hard account freezes on first-time alerts, and feed analyst disposition labels into quarterly supervised XGBoost retraining.
